reviews.title: Excellent Addition to the Survival Genre!
reviews.text:
I’ve played a LOT of games like this: LDoE, Grim Soul, Frostborn, Westland Survival, and some others I forget the name of. At some point in the others, I get annoyed at the constant attacks on my base, other players taking all my best loot, the necessity of spending money to progress, and infrequent updates. I’m happy to say that I don’t have those issues with this game! Other players don’t take all your loot, you just lose some durability to your weapons and armor. Attacks on your base are infrequent and you can always prepare for them. I haven’t had to spend a single cent to progress to level 40! And the updates so far are timely and frequent. The creature collector aspect is also so much fun and unique in this genre!! 

I think I may buy a pack to show my thanks to the devs for this game <3

reviews.title: Good so far, let’s push for better.
reviews.text:
This game really scratches the itch to play more of a game like palworld. Thank you for making this. Especially for the phone version. 

With that said, I’d love to see more improvements:

1. Healing in the game is dependent on herbs and bandages that you find and craft, but no healing takes place when you’re at camp. This is a problem because if you’ve just done the area and hit 1hp with nothing to heal you, you are going out into the wilderness pretty much ready to die for real this time. Same with pets. Healing takes forever for these guys and there aren’t very many items to heal them with, that are readily available until god knows when. Of my pets is taking forever to heal, I cannot go out into the wilderness again for a while. Please fix this..

2. DNA samples are rather hard to come by and don’t seem to come from anywhere other than quest completion? This makes it impossible to get an even ok pet at your character’s level. And with the slow healing, it makes it difficult to have enough pets ready to fights.

3. Repairs and equipment crafting goes straight into storage. And I’ve nearly called it quits a few times trying to go into the wilderness when the new equipment I just crafted was left back at camp. Please fix this. There is no reason all stuff crafted to be kidnapped each time it’s made.

4. Pricing!!! Is horrible and unclear!! You have two tiers: premium and elite, each costing $5/$10 per quest tab (5)!! That’s $75 if you were to buy all of the unlocks alone.

Purchasing the elite tier doesn’t even cover the pervious premium tier. You’d be better off providing pricing for the premium tier for all the quest tabs, and having the elite unlock everything.

Given what was unlocked from the single $10 purchase I spent on this game, I’m incredibly disappointed. 

5. The audio of the main character’s voice when it takes damage, rules the whole game sound track. I’ve been playing the game on mute to avoid listening to it. Idk if you can fix this but that would be much appreciated. 

6. It would help if we could to communicate or party up with other players. Unless you intend for this to be a solo/pvp game. Which is all good.

reviews.title: Balance?
reviews.text:
Free games need to have a balance of micro transactions to support the development team/earn money,  and a system that supports the players and keeps them engaged and able to play for a long time. In my opinion, the latter will make the dev’s even more money. 

I stopped playing after about 1-2 weeks because I couldn’t keep up with the games micros transactions. Just one example is this: you have to buy an item that lets you have more than 1 Amikin at a time. It breaks quickly, and when broken, limits you to 1 Amikin. It also costs a lot of resources to repair. They give you the option to spend actual money to fix it instead. If you choose to do so, you will then be able to use it for 1 more hour before it breaks again, and then it’s rinse and repeat. This is only one example, but it’s the design of the game. Make in-game items difficult to create/repair but easy to buy.

This game isn’t balanced in that aspect, and the scale unfortunately leans towards the side of greed. If the dev’s fix this, I’ll be back.

Recent update ruins the game for me. Leveling up takes a while so when you have Amikin with good abilities, if they’re level isn’t high enough, they’re basically useless. When you go outside of the first two unlockable areas, Amikin with lower levels or hp die almost immediately because a wild Amikin from across the map attacks you so you can’t really avoid combat. It’s hard to level up an Amikin that dies 30 seconds after you start.

reviews.title: Equipment update
reviews.text:

They added equipment grades, meaning gear made can have added effects. Neat! However they got rid of the repair bench that we had used to maintain our gear. Not great! 
So you grind to make the gear until you get a good one, then eventually its just gonna fall apart. 
I hope they add the repair bench back in, but in the mean time, just be ready to grind for supplies for multiple crafts of the gear you want, and don’t get too attached to a good set.
